name: Nicobari Chicken Curry
instructions: 1. Heat coconut oil in a heavy-bottomed pan and add mustard seeds and curry leaves until they splutter.
2. Add sliced onions and sauté until translucent.
3. Add ginger-garlic paste and green chilies, cooking until the raw smell disappears.
4. Stir in the turmeric, coriander powder, and red chili powder, mixing well.
5. Add the chicken pieces and sear them until they change color.
6. Pour in the coconut milk and season with salt, then simmer on low heat until the chicken is tender and the gravy thickens.
7. Remove from heat and serve hot with steamed rice.
description: Nicobari Chicken Curry is a staple dish from the Nicobar Islands, reflecting the indigenous culinary influence of using abundant local produce like coconut. It is a simple, home-style dish that relies on the freshness of coconut milk to provide a mild, creamy texture, commonly served during community gatherings and local festivities.
